about: End-to-end spot checks of SCOOP's agents, run against a live workspace server by evaluation/spot_checks.py. Each is also a demo (docs/demos.md). 'field' is a field key the server has (null: a fresh search). Expectations: calls/not_calls (the chat agent's tools), actions (map action types), artifacts/no_artifacts (artifact kinds), text (regexes the answer must all match), max_failures (failed tool calls, sub-agents' included), max_seconds.

checks.title: Draco: members and bulk proper motion, against the literature
checks.shows: chat agent -> proper-motion agent; its own member selection on the map; a maximum-likelihood fit compared with Pace et al. 2022
checks.message: can you do a bulk proper motion measurement for draco? population fitting after identifying likely members?

checks.title: Draco: trusted QSOs inside HST/JWST images
checks.shows: field analysis (match across three QSO catalogs and footprints), highlighted on the map with time baselines
checks.message: Which trusted QSOs fall inside HST or JWST images here, and what time baselines do they have?

checks.title: A fresh search: Gaia stars around TRAPPIST-1
checks.shows: start-page question -> data agent sizes the request in a second, starts a Gaia + galaxies field that loads by itself
checks.message: Show me the Gaia stars within 8 arcmin of TRAPPIST-1.

checks.title: Too big to start without asking: a degree around the Galactic centre
checks.shows: the data agent sizes the request (~10^5-10^6 Gaia sources) and asks before downloading anything
checks.message: Get me the Gaia data in a 60 arcmin cone around Sgr A*.

checks.title: Beyond cones: GD-1 around the spur, with cuts in the stream's frame
checks.shows: galstreams track, a band region outlined on the map, sizes and proposed stream-frame proper-motion cuts for the user to confirm
checks.message: I want Gaia data along the GD-1 stream, within 10 degrees of phi1 on either side of the spur (phi1 around -33 in the Koposov frame). What would that look like?

checks.title: Literature: recent proper-motion papers on Draco
checks.shows: ADS search with bibcodes that become links
checks.message: What are the most recent papers measuring Draco's proper motion? Give bibcodes.

checks.title: Leo II: velocities from the literature onto the RV panels
checks.shows: data agent adds a VizieR RV catalog; the RVs reach the Gaia stars and the RV histogram opens
checks.message: Show me the line-of-sight velocity distribution of Leo II's stars.

checks.title: Exoplanets: TRAPPIST-1's planets, every claim checked
checks.shows: the exoplanet agent's quoted, code-checked answer, relayed word for word
checks.message: How many confirmed planets does TRAPPIST-1 have, and what are their orbital periods?
